summary.text: Chip Curry (listed on Ballotpedia as Glenn Curry, also known as Chip) is a Democratic state senator from Belfast, Maine, who has represented Senate District 11 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Curry lives in Belfast, Maine, and has served as the chair of the Maine Community Foundation's Waldo County Fund and co-chair of the UMA Professional Employees Association.
He assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 1, 2020, succeeding Erin Herbig.

For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee, the Senate Engrossed Bills Committee and the Senatorial Vote Committee, and he chairs the Housing and Economic Development Committee.
Curry advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
